resolution.openItem: One of the two original failures was NEVER read - the second FAIL block was not rendered in the implementer's captured output. The reviewer's causal lead, recorded so it is not lost: the printed stderr names add-billing (machine A's change, archived at store-lifecycle.test.ts:325-331 BEFORE machine B clones at :349-353) as still active, which is the signature of machine A's archive step failing first and cascading. This is durable cross-process reservation/archive state, an area with prior defects in this repo, so it is recorded as an open question rather than closed.
resolution.shipDecision: Does NOT block ship on the evidence available: two independent uncontaminated runs on the same commit are clean, and no mechanism linking the failure to this Layer-0 diff has been established. Carried forward as a recorded open item, not silently dropped.
